primitives.name: Design Token Compliance Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Design token drift check**: ```bash # Check for hardcoded hex values in the component file grep -E "#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}" apps/web/components/[ComponentName].tsx ``` This should return zero matches.
primitives.assumptions: Compliance decreases linearly with number of hardcoded values.
primitives.breakdown_regime: C = 1 − H · k, where k is a fixed constant

layer2.mapping: Token compliance kernel derives from regex-based drift detection and enforces design system integrity.
layer2.telemetry: Zero hardcoded hex values returned by grep
